# Employee Handbook — Fixture Policy

## 1. Purpose
This policy explains how employees request time away from work.

## 2. Requests

### 2.1 Planned Absences
Employees submit a request at least 10 days in advance.

- Requests go to the direct manager.
- Human Resources records approved requests.

### 2.2 Procedure

1. Report the absence
   1. Notify the manager before the shift starts.
   2. Give the expected duration.

2. Return to work
   1. Confirm the return date with the manager.

## 3. Exceptions
A manager may waive the notice period in an emergency.
